Lovable execution loop for the two PKT-004 drilldown modules has been reviewed and documented. Owner work completed:

1. Verified sibling front repo contains the four capital/binding pages, four deployment/approval pages, mirrored feedback bundles, and ui-done/frontend-feedback requests.
2. Re-ran sibling repo static validation: npm run build and targeted ESLint passed for the touched PKT-004 files.
3. Re-ran Pantheon-side seeded FastAPI smoke for the eight read routes; list/detail endpoints returned 200 and read RBAC remained 403 for viewer, 401 for missing auth.
4. Added Pantheon delivery evidence:
   - docs/pantheon-delivery/PKT-004-capital-binding-drilldowns/DELIVERY_NOTE.md
   - docs/pantheon-delivery/PKT-004-capital-binding-drilldowns/CONTRACT_LOCK.json

Blocking findings recorded in both delivery notes:
- the returned request pair for each module is not replayable from source_commit faa1bc2d1bd02e0a3d9fc1e1e5c35bc510182ea7
- src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx still never persists pantheon_operator_token, so the correct BFF client code still sends anonymous live requests unless localStorage is seeded manually

Please review whether BP6-LUV-013 should be approved as a completed Lovable loop with explicit follow-up evidence, or whether you want an additional task created for the front-owned replay/auth fixes before approval.

Review not approved. See .coordination/reviews/BP6-LUV-013-review.md. Acceptance is still unmet: both PKT-004 lovable-ui-task packets remain status: ready, the returned request pairs are not replayable from source_commit faa1bc2d1bd02e0a3d9fc1e1e5c35bc510182ea7, and AuthProvider still never persists pantheon_operator_token. Coordinate the front-owned replay/auth follow-up and align Pantheon packet status before re-review.

Owner follow-up is complete and ready for re-review. Pantheon-side loop state now matches the reviewed outcome: both PKT-004 lovable-ui-task packets are status loop-complete, delivery evidence was refreshed, the sibling front repo request pairs are replayable from transport commit 46a7a947fee0a375007115df100bac1d84e06e82 (metadata commit d5849b7cc33a7c26c8d6d86eab105553258eed1b points source_commit there), and src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx now persists/clears pantheon_operator_token through session bootstrap, sign-in, and sign-out. Verification rerun: npm run build passed in ../front-ai-trading-system; replayability was confirmed with git show against the transport commit.

Review approved: both PKT-004 lovable-ui-task packets are loop-complete, the sibling front repo request pairs are replayable from transport commit 46a7a947fee0a375007115df100bac1d84e06e82 via metadata commit d5849b7cc33a7c26c8d6d86eab105553258eed1b, AuthProvider now persists pantheon_operator_token through bootstrap/sign-in/sign-out, and ../front-ai-trading-system npm run build passed.
